problems.issue: The connective 'so' links two logically independent OPEN questions: the war-chest CAUSE of cash accumulation (why the firm holds cash) and the SOURCE of the CEO's uncertainty (compliance-constrained 'cannot speak' vs strategic 'will not speak'). The bright lines list these as SEPARATE open items. Read literally, 'the war-chest channel ... remains unestablished, so two readings ... remain observationally equivalent' implies the unestablished war-chest is what makes the compliance-vs-strategic readings equivalent. But resolving why firms accumulate cash would not resolve which reading of the hedging is correct, and failing to establish it does not cause that ambiguity; the two are independent. (A second, valid reading attaches 'so' to the broader 'establishes no mechanism' clause, under which observational equivalence does follow, so this is an ambiguous connective rather than a hard non-sequitur.) The intro mirror 1-P8-a keeps the two separate ('...offered as motivation, not identification -- while the source of the uncertainty ... remains observationally equivalent'), never invoking the war-chest, which shows the disambiguating fix touches no hedge.
problems.evidence: 5-P5-a: 'the design supports no causal identification and establishes no mechanism: the concentration in cash deals is motivated in Section 2 but not identified, and the war-chest channel behind cash accumulation in particular remains unestablished, so two readings, a compliance-constrained inability to speak and a strategically chosen reticence, remain observationally equivalent.' Contrast intro mirror 1-P8-a, which separates them with 'while' and no war-chest clause.
problems.rule_broken: Connective ('so') asserts a cause/consequence relation between two premises that do not support it -- two independent open questions (cash-accumulation CAUSE vs uncertainty SOURCE) falsely linked, where the bright lines hold them open separately.

proposed_fix.why: Decouples the two independent open questions so the sentence no longer implies that resolving the cash-accumulation cause would resolve the compliance-vs-strategic ambiguity. But the three SUPPORTED sources establish scripted/earnings-channel management ONLY: Shleifer-Vishny = a valuation/currency motive, Louis = pre-deal abnormal accruals (earnings numbers), Thewissen = earnings-press-release TONE. None reaches the firm's UNSCRIPTED Q&A uncertainty, so the cited support does not back the specific by-product attenuation channel it is invoked for. IMPORTANT: masking-as-motivation is CORRECT and must stay; the prop is properly hedged ('plausibly', 'interpretation, not detection', INCONCLUSIVE_MANUAL, with an honesty floor stating stock is a noisy flat null, not suppressed). This is a narrow evidence-reach flag, NOT an attack on the hedge.
problems.evidence: statement: 'the same broad optimism disposition plausibly dampens their unguarded Q&A uncertainty as a by-product, while cash bidders -- lacking the currency motive -- carry the disclosure strain into the unscripted answers more cleanly ... it is interpretation, not detection.' note: 'Evidence = callback to 2.1 P5 (S-V / Louis / thewissen, SUPPORTED) + the result (C6 ... 0.0983**) + data (cash +0.0461***, stock -0.0429 n.s.).' Appendix P5.2 = 'a powerful incentive for firms to get their equity overvalued, so that they can make acquisitions with stock' (valuation); P5.3 = 'a jump in the abnormal accrual in the quarter immediately prior to the merger announcement' (earnings); P5.4 = 'tone of earnings press releases significantly increases by 15%' (scripted tone) -- none about Q&A.
problems.rule_broken: evidence cited for something it does not establish: scripted/earnings sources (S-V/Louis/thewissen) used to back an unscripted-Q&A attenuation by-product they never test

proposed_fix.from: the same broad optimism disposition plausibly dampens their unguarded Q&A uncertainty as a by-product
proposed_fix.to: Keep the clause, but ensure the prose (and this note) mark the unscripted-Q&A by-product as the authors' OWN conjecture, explicitly NOT established by S-V/Louis/thewissen (which document only scripted tone and earnings-number management); retain the masking-as-motivation status and the 'noisy flat null, not suppressed' honesty floor.
proposed_fix.why: The by-product attenuation is the load-bearing interpretive bridge for 'cash > stock,' yet rides on a 'SUPPORTED' callback that does not reach the Q&A channel. The motivation is legitimate and must stay; only its evidentiary reach needs to be stated accurately so a referee does not read the cited papers as proving a Q&A dampening.
